nodes.label: Next.js Wordmark SVG
nodes.description: Official Next.js framework wordmark logo rendered as an SVG. Displays the text 'NEXT.JS' in solid black on a transparent background (394x80 viewBox). Uses filled path data to form the letters N, E, X, T, J, S — the standard Next.js brand asset typically used in footers, README files, and 'built with' sections.
